analytics.noAccessTitle: Usage analytics aren't available to your role
analytics.noAccessBody: Ask an administrator for the analytics permission if you need to review unused assets.

period.label: Not used for
period.invalid: Enter a whole number up to {{max}} years.

unused.title: Not used
unused.pageDesc: Assets with no recorded use in the chosen period - candidates to refresh, promote or retire.
unused.desc: Assets with no recorded download, share, embed or playback in the chosen period.
unused.summaryPublished_one: published asset not used in the last {{period}}
unused.summaryPublished_other: published assets not used in the last {{period}}
unused.summaryAll_one: asset not used in the last {{period}}
unused.summaryAll_other: assets not used in the last {{period}}
unused.exportCapped: The export stops at 5,000 assets - narrow the filters for the rest.
unused.caption: Assets not used in the last {{period}}
unused.confirmBody_one: It will be unpublished and moved to the archive, so it stops being available for delivery. You can restore it later by withdrawing it back to draft.
unused.confirmBody_other: They will be unpublished and moved to the archive, so they stop being available for delivery. You can restore each one later by withdrawing it back to draft.
unused.emptyTitle: Everything has been used in the last {{period}}
unused.emptyBody: Nothing to retire right now. Try a shorter period to see what has gone quiet.
unused.foot: Use is counted from downloads, shared links, embeds and playback reported by connected systems. Previews inside Orbit don't count, and an asset is only flagged once it is older than the period.

insights.topEmptyBody: The most used assets appear here once downloads and shares are recorded.
